reference_sheets.prompt: Use both approved traveler PNGs. Identity sheet for museum explanation. Front, three-quarter body and side profile; right palm open beside exhibit at waist height, relaxed left hand, both eyes open. Preserve jacket, backpack, hair, beard and 2D line shading. Neutral curious expression. Only required poses, no action inside historical spacecraft.

Photographic object reference sheet using NASA AS13-62-9004 and S70-35395. Same square Apollo CM lithium hydroxide cartridge in front, side and three-quarter views. Distinguish plain cartridge, cardboard/plastic bag/tape sleeve, and final sealed white cloth-wrapped hose assembly. Preserve metal mesh face, proportions and tube connection. State labels outside image may be added only for QA contact sheet.

Photoreal LM Aquarius cabin reference sheet from NASA photographs. Fix cramped ivory equipment panels, fabric bags, white wrapped hoses, mesh storage and handholds. Show toward docking hatch, opposite corner, and equipment close-up. Three white-clothed crew members without helmets, filmed from backs and partial side views. Do not use movie actors. Exact panel labels require a separate verified close-up.

Two separate photoreal environment reference compositions based on supplied NASA photos. A ground CO2 adapter test rig and the 1970 Mission Control room with gray-green console rows, blue CRTs, paper, headset operators. Keep the lab and control room distinct, consistent fluorescent practical lighting.

Photoreal Apollo command module interior reference sheet. Obtain and open dedicated NASA cockpit/storage photos before generation. Preserve real CM geometry, seats, instrument panels and storage. No modern ISS walls or large standing room.
